#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
project=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd -P)
if [[ ! -x "$project/runtime/rootfs/usr/bin/darling" ]]; then
    echo "Darling runtime is not installed in $project/runtime/rootfs" >&2
    exit 1
fi
exec 9>"$project/runtime/session.lock"
flock 9
if [[ -f "$project/runtime/state/host-cpu-haswell.json" ]]; then
    if [[ ! -x "$project/runtime/tools/check-haswell-host" ]]; then
        echo "The project x86_64h runtime requires its CPU/OS launch guard." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    "$project/runtime/tools/check-haswell-host" --require
fi
if [[ ${1:-} == shell ]]; then
    shift
fi
exec unshare --user --map-root-user --mount --pid --fork --kill-child \
    "$project/runtime/native-codesign-ci-v3/runtime-ns.sh" "$project" "$@"
